import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(root / 'scripts'))
import stability

meta = json.loads((root / 'artifacts/setup-pressure-candidate.json').read_text())
server = root / meta['directory'] / 'war-relay'
stress = root / 'artifacts/baselines/address-churn-client/stress'
sha = lambda path: hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
output = root / 'docs/benchmarks/2026-10-16-setup-pressure-stability.json'
record = {
    'source_revision': meta['source_revision'], 'server_sha256': sha(server),
    'stress_sha256': sha(stress), 'driver_source': Path(__file__).read_text(),
    'helpers': {name: sha(root / 'scripts' / name) for name in ['stability.py', 'benchmark.py']},
    'scope': 'Four separate four-second fresh four-worker cases, 32 clients; IP quota64 enabled, server CPUs0-3/client4-7. Churn uses4096 loopback source IPs and verifies welcome, complete self-echo, exact Close/EOF. Fanout uses27 readers and4 unread peers, 1ms delay, cyclic256/1024/65536/262144-byte values, window16. Full body/FIFO/counter/cleanup checks. Fault injection and ordinary guard timings ran separately.',
    'cases': [], 'passed': False,
}
for mode in ['traffic', 'churn', 'slow', 'fanout']:
    case = stability.run_case(
        mode, 4, 32, server_binary=server, stress_binary=stress,
        server_cpus='0-3', client_cpus='4-7', server_args=['--max-connections-per-ip', '64'],
        source_addresses=4096 if mode == 'churn' else 0,
        payload_sizes=[256, 1024, 65536, 262144] if mode == 'fanout' else None,
        unread_clients=4 if mode == 'fanout' else 0,
        reader_delay_ms=1 if mode == 'fanout' else 0,
    )
    record['cases'].append(case)
    output.write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + '\n')
    assert case['passed'] and case['server_exit_code'] == case['exit_code'] == 0
    assert not case['server_forced_kill']
    final = case['final']['metrics']
    for name in ['war_accept_errors_total', 'war_setup_errors_total', 'war_ip_rejected_total',
                 'war_output_queue_capacity_bytes', 'war_read_buffer_reserved_bytes']:
        assert int(final[name]) == 0, (name, final[name])
    result = next(entry for entry in case['output'] if entry.get('event') == 'result')
    print(json.dumps({'mode': mode, 'passed': case['passed'], 'verified': result['verified_deliveries']}), flush=True)
record['passed'] = True
output.write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + '\n')
